annotations.title: 事業計画の前提チェック / Business plan assumption check

description: Review unit economics using acquisition cost, monthly customer revenue, gross margin and churn; optionally include growth and cash runway pairs. Returns lifetime gross profit, acquisition-cost multiple, payback months, optional projections and general reference cautions. 計画の前提を見直すために獲得単価・月売上・粗利率・月解約率と任意の成長・資金を入力し、粗利・倍率・回収月数・注意点を返します。 Set language to 'en' for English output.

cash_on_hand.description: Available cash, 0–1 trillion; same currency unit as all other monetary inputs. Specify together with monthly_burn. / 手元資金。0〜1兆。金額はすべて同じ通貨単位。monthly_burnと対で指定。

customer_acquisition_cost.description: Acquisition cost per customer, 0–1 trillion; all monetary inputs use the same currency unit. / 顧客獲得単価。0〜1兆。金額はすべて同じ通貨単位。

gross_margin_percent.description: Gross margin percentage, 0–100; 10 means 10%. / 粗利率。0〜100の百分率。10は10%。

growth_months.description: Growth duration, 1–60 months; specify together with monthly_growth_percent. / 成長の月数（1〜60）。monthly_growth_percentと対で指定。

language.description: Output language: ja (default) or en. / 出力言語。既定は日本語（ja）、英語はen。

monthly_burn.description: Monthly net cash outflow, 0–1 trillion; same currency unit as all other monetary inputs. Specify together with cash_on_hand. / 月の純資金流出。0〜1兆。金額はすべて同じ通貨単位。cash_on_handと対で指定。

monthly_churn_percent.description: Monthly churn percentage, greater than 0 and at most 100; 10 means 10%. / 月解約率。0より大きく100以下の百分率。10は10%。

monthly_growth_percent.description: Relative monthly growth percentage, -100–1000; 10 means 10%. Specify together with growth_months. / 月の相対成長率。−100〜1000の百分率。10は10%。growth_monthsと対で指定。

monthly_revenue_per_customer.description: Monthly revenue per customer, 0–1 trillion; all monetary inputs use the same currency unit. / 顧客1人の月売上。0〜1兆。金額はすべて同じ通貨単位。

name: check_business_plan_assumptions

acquisition_cost_multiple.description: Lifetime gross profit divided by acquisition cost, or null. / 生涯粗利を獲得単価で割った倍率。算出不可はnull。

cash_runway_months.description: Cash divided by monthly net cash outflow, or null. / 手元資金を月の純資金流出で割った月数。算出不可はnull。

growth_multiplier.description: Compound growth multiplier over the specified duration. / 指定月数の複利成長倍率。

lifetime_gross_profit.description: Lifetime gross profit per customer, in the input currency unit. / 入力と同じ通貨単位での顧客生涯の粗利。

monthly_gross_profit.description: Monthly gross profit per customer, in the input currency unit. / 入力と同じ通貨単位での顧客1人の月粗利。

payback_months.description: Acquisition cost divided by monthly gross profit, or null. / 獲得単価を月粗利で割った回収月数。算出不可はnull。

summary.description: Calculation assumptions and interpretation. / 計算の前提と結果の説明。

warnings.description: Data cautions and general reference thresholds. / データの注意点と一般的な目安。

title: 事業計画の前提チェック / Business plan assumption check
